findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks the service query API
findings.body: This replaces the public `findMany` method with `getBaseConditions`, which only returns a SQL condition and does not execute a query or accept the previous selection and caller-supplied filters. Existing callers of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` will fail to compile (or fail at runtime if they are not type-checked), and there is no equivalent query method in this class. Preserve the method or migrate all callers as part of this change.
